svg.title: Повороты таза стоя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing pelvis rotation in two successive poses, straight-on view. Feet hip-width, shoes stay planted pointing toward viewer, knees soft, chest and head facing viewer, hands on hip bones. LEFT hips slightly rotated toward left with left hand further back; RIGHT hips visibly rotated toward right with right hand further back. Belt and shorts center seam show opposite pelvis directions, shoulders remain square. No weights, seat or swinging arms. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
